C-CALIBRATION-COMMAND-EVIDENCE.Summary: P0.8 (forward path only): record MustPassCommand / MustPassBudget evaluation as durable foldable run/ events, and have fold adjudicate CalibrationAdjudication from those records — not from a live runCommands spawn and never from report-time evaluateTargetComplete. No migration of the three historical pending pairs (D8.4).
C-CALIBRATION-COMMAND-EVIDENCE.Problem:
The product thesis is that the agent cannot lie to the model. Calibration pairs are meant to be durable labels stored at fold (Correction 156): *"a corpus whose labels move is not a corpus."* Today, any change that carries claimedConfidence and a MustPassCommand on TargetAssertions freezes outcome="pending" at fold, permanently, because fold never has durable command evidence to consult.
Measured at HEAD (p0-calibration-derivation.md, doctor): 2 included, 0 excluded, 3 pending, 1 backfilled. The three pending archives — C-ADOPTION-SURFACE, C-PLAN-QUALITY, C-REVIEW-LANGUAGE-SCOPE — each store CalibrationAdjudication outcome="pending" adjudicatedAt="fold" with reason: "MustPassCommand or MustPassBudget evidence was not executed (command execution not opted in); complete is not evaluable from structural target assertions alone"
That reason is not a report-time invention. buildCalibrationAdjudicationAtFold (grace-cursor.ts) calls evaluateTargetComplete, which hardcodes runCommands: false (grace-cursor.ts:1512). evaluateMustPassCommand (artifact/assertions.ts:287–301) then emits assertion.command-not-evaluated; complete becomes undefined; fold stores pending. When runCommands *is* true (ngrace lint --run-commands), the same helper spawns the shell, checks exitCode, and on success returns an empty issue list — **the evidence is discarded at the moment it exists.** No CommandRun / CommandEvidence type exists in src/ or under .ngrace/.
P0.8's plan wording describes pending after a final --run-commands *succeeded*. The derivation established **there is no such case in this repository**: no durable record that those three bundles' commands ever passed. The work is therefore **purely forward-looking**. Relabelling the three historical pendings would violate D8.4 and Correction 156. Doctor is an honest reader of an incomplete fold-time snapshot — the defect is a **recorder** gap, not a reader gap.
D6.6 (and the types) close the late-evidence door: CalibrationRestatement carries no outcome, and report.ts keeps pending pairs pending regardless of adjudicatedAt (A7.2). After fold there is no honest path from pending to a boolean without a new mechanism that moves labels after the fact — which Correction 156 forbids. Evidence must exist **before** fold adjudicates.

Goals.Goal: When MustPassCommand / MustPassBudget is evaluated with explicit runCommands opt-in, each evaluation leaves a durable foldable run/ event recording at least command identity, exitCode, and evaluation source (D6.3(c)).

At fold, when claimedConfidence attempts exist, adjudicate complete from structural target assertions plus matching recorded command-run evidence via a **new fold join helper** — not by extending evaluateTargetComplete into a report-reachable spawn path, and not by setting runCommands true at fold (D6.3(b) not authorized). Still write one CalibrationAdjudication with adjudicatedAt=fold (D6.5).
Keep collectCalibrationReport / doctor free of evaluateTargetComplete and free of command spawning (D6.5 / corr 156). Prove it with a regression that instruments evaluateTargetComplete to throw.
Leave the three historical pending pairs pending; document forward-only scope (D8.4). Do not invent outcome-carrying restatements (D6.6).

Constraints.Constraint: Binding decisions: D6.1–D6.6, D8.1, D8.4, D8.5, D5.2; Correction 156 / 161; A5.2 (default lint does not execute command assertions); A29.2 / F1 (binary writes structural state with explicit apply — the --run-commands / assertion opt-in is the operator act; exit codes are derived from the spawn just performed).
D6.5 — must not remove or weaken fold-time storage of CalibrationAdjudication; must not introduce any report-time call to evaluateTargetComplete.

D6.3(c) only. (a) report-time re-evaluation is forbidden. (b) fold-time runCommands spawn is not authorized by this bundle; if (c) proves expensive, stop and report (D8.5) — cost is not a licence to slide to (b).
D6.6 — command-run evidence must exist before fold adjudicates. Do not propose or implement an outcome-carrying CalibrationRestatement. Restatement remains adjudicatedAt/provenance only.

Evidence is a **foldable run/ event** (not a run-ledger-only section): append-only, digestable into WriteEvidence, subject to epoch membership/density with other loose events. Event kind / payload shape is the plan's choice within additive grammar (D5.2: no NGRACE_ARTIFACT_VERSION bump for additive records). If the grammar forces more than an additive tag, stop and report.

Evidence doctrine: TraceAssertion + tests default. Write each regression first, watch it fail on pre-fix code, then fix. Red-first includes the throw-instrumented report path and the "ran but recorded nothing" discriminating negative.

No durable-scope overlap expected with active C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE (draft spec, no plan, no ObservedWriteScope; targets gates/ledger three-exit under M-GATES / M-REVIEW). Confirm at plan time; do not expand this bundle into gates/ledger.ts.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Migration, repair, restatement, or re-label of C-ADOPTION-SURFACE, C-PLAN-QUALITY, or C-REVIEW-LANGUAGE-SCOPE Epoch-1 pending pairs (D8.4 / corr 156 / D6.6). They stay pending permanently.
Fold-time command spawning (D6.3 shape (b)) — not authorized; D8.5 forbids adopting it as a cost fallback.
Doctor-side or report-time re-evaluation of target assertions or MustPassCommand (D6.3(a) / D6.5).
Outcome-carrying CalibrationRestatement or any mechanism that moves a stored pending label to pass/fail after fold (D6.6 / corr 156).
Making claimedConfidence gate-consumed; changing calibration promotion bars; redesign of CalibrationAdjudication schema beyond what fold must write for (c).
C-REPORT-HONESTY territory: P0.7, P0.9, and findings F11, F14, F15 (and related review porcelain / archive wording work).
C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE (wrapperFromLedger three-exit); edits under src/gates/ledger.ts or plan-quality read classification.
NGRACE_ARTIFACT_VERSION bump for additive evidence records (D5.2). If a bump is forced by grammar shape, stop and report rather than ship it silently.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-COMMAND-EVIDENCE-RECORDED: When ngrace lint (or the designated assertion surface that sets runCommands) evaluates a plan's MustPassCommand / MustPassBudget with explicit command-execution opt-in, each evaluated command leaves a durable foldable run/ event (CommandRunEvidence or the plan's agreed kind) recording at least: command identity (text or stable assertion reference), exitCode, and evaluation source. Both success (exitCode 0) and failure (non-zero) must be recorded. Discriminating negative: a path that runs the command and returns only lint issues (empty issue list on success) without writing a durable run/ event **fails this criterion** — that is today's behaviour (evaluateMustPassCommand discarding the spawn result) and must not remain the sole outcome. When runCommands is false, commands are still not executed and no evidence events are invented.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-FOLD-ADJUDICATES-FROM-RECORDS: Given claimedConfidence attempts on an open epoch and durable command-run evidence covering every MustPassCommand / MustPassBudget on TargetAssertions with exitCode 0, and structural target assertions otherwise clean, fold writes CalibrationAdjudication outcome="pass" adjudicatedAt="fold". Given at least one recorded non-zero exitCode for a required command, fold writes outcome="fail". Given a required command with **no** matching recorded evidence, fold writes outcome="pending" with a reason that names **absent recorded evidence** (ledger gap), not a live re-spawn. Adjudication uses a **new fold join helper**; it must not set runCommands true to spawn shells at fold (unless D6.3(b) is separately authorized — it is not in this bundle). A fold path that only calls evaluateTargetComplete with runCommands false and ignores existing evidence events fails this criterion.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NO-REPORT-TIME-REEVAL: collectCalibrationReport and ngrace doctor calibration output do not call evaluateTargetComplete and do not spawn MustPassCommand / MustPassBudget. Regression required in suite form (not merely asserted in prose): with evaluateTargetComplete **instrumented to throw**, doctor (or collectCalibrationReport as consumed by doctor) must still emit the calibration section from stored pairs without invoking the throw. A change that re-introduces report-time evaluateTargetComplete, or that only "avoids" it by dead code still reachable from doctor, fails this criterion.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-HISTORICAL-PENDING-UNCHANGED: After this change lands, ngrace doctor still reports C-ADOPTION-SURFACE Epoch-1, C-PLAN-QUALITY Epoch-1, and C-REVIEW-LANGUAGE-SCOPE Epoch-1 as pending (bucket pending, adjudicatedAt=fold or equivalent durable pending presentation). Product text may document them as permanent forward-fixed pendings (D8.4). A change that flips any of those three to included/pass (or otherwise rewrites their stored CalibrationAdjudication outcome) **fails this criterion** — there is no honest mechanism to do so (D8.4, corr 156, D6.6). Helpful "cleanup" of the three pendings is out of scope and fails the bar.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-D65-FOLD-STILL-STORES: Fold still writes CalibrationAdjudication when claimedConfidence attempts exist; collectCalibrationReport still refuses to invent labels when the section is absent (pending/excluded paths unchanged in spirit). A "fix" that removes fold-time storage and recomputes labels at report time fails this criterion (D6.5).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SUITE-AND-LINT: Suite green for red-first regressions covering: (1) run-with-opt-in writes evidence events; (2) fold pass/fail/pending from records as in AC-FOLD-ADJUDICATES-FROM-RECORDS; (3) throw-instrumented AC-NO-REPORT-TIME-REEVAL; (4) historical three still pending. bun run ngrace lint --path . is 0 errors and 0 warnings unless an authorized scope.durable-overlap is declared at plan approval (none expected vs C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE while it remains plan-less). bun run validate:ci green. Red-first is required; a green-only demonstration of any AC fails this criterion.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Unit and CLI regressions under src/artifact/assertions.test.ts (and/or related assertion tests), src/lint or grace-lint paths for --run-commands write-through, src/grace-cursor.test.ts for fold join from evidence events, and src/calibration/report.test.ts (and/or doctor-facing tests) for the throw-instrumented no-report-time-reeval bar and historical pending stability. Dogfooding: bun run ngrace lint --path . at 0 errors / 0 warnings (or authorized overlap only); bun run ngrace doctor --path . still lists the three historical pendings; validate:ci green. TraceAssertion-backed verification for M-ASSERTIONS, M-CURSOR, M-CALIBRATION, M-LINT-CORE as already declared; no new Marker evidence. No report-time evaluateTargetComplete. No NGRACE_ARTIFACT_VERSION bump unless authority-authorized after a stop-and-report.

Assumptions.Assumption: Module ownership confirmed against .ngrace/graph/main.xml and MODULE_CONTRACT LINKS: M-ASSERTIONS Path src/artifact/assertions.ts; M-LINT-CORE Path src/lint/core.ts; M-CURSOR Path src/grace-cursor.ts; M-CALIBRATION Path src/calibration/report.ts. M-LINT-CORE is claimed because --run-commands plumbing and context that reach evaluateMustPassCommand today flow through lintGraceProject (lint/core.ts); if the plan finds the write can live solely in assertions.ts with no lint/core change, M-LINT-CORE may drop at plan time with an explicit note — do not silently omit it without re-checking call paths.

M-DOCTOR is not claimed: doctor only consumes collectCalibrationReport. Criteria that name doctor are satisfied by testing collectCalibrationReport and/or doctor without editing grace-doctor.ts. If implementation must change doctor output shape, stop and report (new module surface).

M-GRAMMAR / M-ARTIFACT-TYPES are not claimed a priori: evidence is an additive run/ event kind under existing EVENT_FILENAME (id-task-kind.xml). If grammar validation rejects unknown kinds and requires types.ts / grammar.ts edits beyond an additive allowlist entry, that remains in scope only as far as D5.2 allows without a version bump; otherwise stop and report (authority Q5).

p0-calibration-derivation.md (measured at a4b9ce7 family) plus D6.1–D6.6, D8.1, D8.4, D8.5 are authoritative for this bundle's under-specifications. P0.8 plan.md wording is read through D6, not literally as retroactive doctor repair.

C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE remains draft-spec with no plan and no ObservedWriteScope at authoring; no durable overlap is expected. If that bundle later claims grace-cursor.ts or assertions.ts, sequential F10.2-style overlap must be declared then — not assumed now.

Exact XML tag/attribute names for the evidence event (e.g. kind="command-run" vs CommandRunEvidence payload) are left to the plan within the foldable run/ event constraint. Spec criteria speak to properties (durable, exitCode, source, fold join), not a frozen schema string.

Matching evidence to plan MustPassCommand values is by command string equality unless the plan documents a stabler id; if command strings are rewritten between plan edit and evidence write, fold may pending — acceptable; do not invent fuzzy match without an authority decision.
The three historical pendings' run-ledger.xml files are not modified by this bundle's implementation or tests (read-only fixtures or copies in temp projects only when a test needs a pending shape).
